instruction: Reset my Spotify queue with all of its recommended songs, shuffle it, and play it.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. The number of recommended songs is only known at runtime, so the problem uses three placeholder song objects (rec-song-1..3) marked (recommended); at execution time the agent issues one add_to_queue per song returned by show_recommendations (all pages). Ordering is enforced structurally: clear_song_queue can run only once and sets (queue-reset); add_to_queue requires (queue-reset), (recommendations-known) and that the song is recommended and not yet queued, and it retracts (queue-shuffled) so shuffling must happen after the last add; play_music requires the queue to be non-empty and shuffled. The evaluation only checks the final MusicPlayer state (is_playing, queue set == recommendations, order not identical/reversed), which this plan satisfies. Because the per-song (in-queue ...) goals are problem-specific they appear only in the problem :goal; supervisor-complete-task's precondition carries the domain-level goal facts (queue-reset, queue-shuffled, music-playing) and all other actions require (not (task-completed)), so complete_task is necessarily last. The task asks no question, so complete_task takes no answer.
